column1: # cells.tsv - explicit growth cells ([GROWTH-SWEEP]). One row per cell SERIES; the n column is a
# comma list, one cell per size. Pattern = pre + unit*n + mid + unit2*n + post, units joined by
# sep; `{i}` = the unit's index, `{j}` = index+1, `{n}` = n. `-` is the empty string.
# Columns (TAB): id family pre unit sep mid unit2 post n stack raise kind expect limit pair red
#   stack  budget (limits.md 3.10 thread) | main (the process's own 8 MB stack)
#   raise  1 = lift the emitted-size caps (reach every pass) | 0 = shipped caps
#   (no features / engine columns: every row runs `all` features, engine 0)
#   kind   stability | limit (a closed set, no default; owner ruling limit-test-criteria, 2026-11-21)
#          stability: sized PAST the named limit; expect refuse:SUBSTR (that limit's diagnostic)
#          limit:     sized JUST BEFORE it (the largest n that compiles, found by bisection);
#                     expect compile, and its matcher must run
#   expect comma list: compile | compile:norun | refuse:SUBSTRING (the diagnostic names the limit)
#   limit  the limit the cell sits just before (limit) or past (stability); a pair names ONE limit
#   pair   `spine/fam` ...: the id a limit cell shares with its stability twin(s) across the same
#          limit; `-` = none (the cell is UNPAIRED: run_growth.py --pairs lists it)
#   red    `ID:KIND`: the known issue and the ONE failure kind it takes (CRASH, TIMEOUT, RUNAWAY,
#          ERROR or refused); a failure of another kind FAILS, and a pass fails the sweep (ratchet)
# compile:norun (limit cells only): the cell must compile but its matcher is NOT built: at the NFA-state and
# VM-node edges (emit caps lifted, raise 1) the emitted C is 25 MB and gcc -O0 needs 10 minutes and 3.4 GB
# (measured on z_cls 131069): an owner question, see the grow4 report. The emit-cap edge cell (alt_lit) runs.
# The memory-family compile cells (lm_cat, lm_cls, lm_alt2: 8 cells) are STABILITY cells past
# PCREC_MAX_VM_EMIT_CODE_BYTES: K150's memory runaway starts near N=4,770 (3 GB), before the cap (about
# N=7,700) can be approached, so no "just before" cell exists for them.
# The limit cells' sizes (2026-11-21, grow4; bisected with the default build, 1 unit past = refused):
#     raise 0): alt_lit 70657 (a limit cell's artifact carries a main(), which counts; its stability twin has none and
#     is refused from 70773).  The empty (`(?:)`) and inl
#     (`(?i)(?-i)`) spine families reach NO named limit (they compile at 400,000 units), so
#     they have no cell here: see the grow4 report.
